_dropped.why: GEIH's own methodology confirms '13 ciudades y áreas metropolitanas' is a domain/tabulation-level within GEIH itself (its own part_of container, invalid). GEIH's sampling frame is built on the 2005 census/2009 update, not the 2018 census node, so no co-censo edge applies either.

The CNPV 2018 ficha metodológica only references census periodicity per UN recommendation generically ('cada diez años'), not a named, citable corpus node. As a foundational instrument, no further upstream dependency is expected.

Reserves' natural methodological basis runs through co-bop (its own part_of container, invalid). A general BanRep reserves explainer cites BPM5 (an older IMF edition) only within a BOP-identity explainer, not as a distinct reserves methodology page.

ICFES's Marco Metodológico cites DANE's DIVIPOLA (territorial codes) and SISE (school-code registry from DANE's EDUC operation) as administrative code references for identifying schools/territories, not as data/methodology inputs to the assessment; neither DIVIPOLA nor EDUC is an existing corpus node.
